tools.name: pay.take_home
tools.description: Use this when someone gives a monthly salary in Ghana cedis and asks what they take home, how much income tax (PAYE) or social security (SSNIT) comes off it, or what an employee costs an employer. tools.name: pay.salary_for_take_home
tools.description: Use this when someone names the monthly amount they want to take home in Ghana cedis and asks what basic salary gives it (for example "what salary do I ask for to take home 5,000 cedis"). Do not use it when the salary is already known: use pay.take_home. Do not use it for contractor fees or business

tools.name: vat.work_out
tools.description: Use this when someone asks to add VAT to an amount in Ghana cedis, or to find the VAT and levies inside a total that already includes them. It applies the standard rate with the NHIL and GETFund levies, all on the same amount. Do not use it for supplies that are exempt or zero-rated, for import duty

tools.name: pay.rates
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what the income tax bands, social security rates or VAT rates are in Ghana, without an amount to work out. Do not use it to work out a figure: use pay.take_home or vat.work_out, which do the arithmetic.
